post.text:
An anti-ICE protester alleges he was struck by a Tennessee Highway Patrol vehicle during an anti-ICE protest.

Here is the dash cam footage:

 https://t.co/kgv1vdXBMS
post.author_description: America’s #1 Alternative News Source | Founded September 2011

description.description: A dashcam video from a Tennessee State Trooper vehicle shows police response to a street demonstration. In the first frame, multiple vehicles are visible on a road at dusk, including civilian cars and police cruisers with active emergency lights. Subsequent frames show the cruiser approaching a crowd of protesters walking in the street. A man in a high-visibility orange safety vest, hat, and striped sleeves walks in front of the trooper's vehicle with both hands raised, one holding what appears to be a radio. In the final frame, the person in the safety vest is seen moving toward the right side of the screen as the trooper's vehicle continues forward toward the group of protesters carrying signs.
